Advanced Composites and Hybrid Materials | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in interface-engineered CoMoN/MXene hybrids with hierarchical nanosheet architecture, revealing asymmetric ion transport—faster charging in pristine CoMoN versus enhanced discharge transport in the hybrid via conductive MXene frameworks and possible K⁺ participation.
